title: VexSource
description: VEX documents read back as suppression rules. A not_affected statement (CycloneDX not_affected or false_positive) becomes a suppression with the document's justification, timestamp and author; fixed or resolved marks the finding remediated; affected, in_triage and exploitable are recorded as triage context; under_investigation is an annotation. Products are matched to findings by purl. A later statement wins. Suppressions a source creates are owned by it: they go when the statement leaves the document, and cannot be deleted by hand. Name exactly one of tea, s3, git, path or urls.

format.description: openvex: OpenVEX 0.2.0. cyclonedx: CycloneDX VEX 1.4 to 1.7 (vulnerabilities[].analysis). auto: decided per document.

scope.description: Which findings the statements may suppress. Left out, the whole tenant.

products.description: TEA products, by TEI or uuid.

requireSignature.description: Refuse a document that is not signed.

allowedAuthors.description: Only statements by these authors (the VEX author field) are used.

refresh.description: When the documents are fetched again: every interval, or when a webhook says they changed.

interval.description: A whole number of minutes, hours or days: 30m, 6h, 1d.

onError.description: When a fetch fails: keep-last keeps the suppressions from the last good fetch; clear removes them.

tea.description: VEX artifacts from a TEA collection, on the Vulnetix TEA publisher or any TEA server. Name exactly one of product, productRelease or collection.

server.description: The TEA API root, or the host whose /.well-known/tea discovery names it.

s3.description: Documents in an S3 bucket, read through a cross-account role whose external id is the tenant uuid (the cloud onboarding trust pattern), or from an S3-compatible endpoint (R2, MinIO). Name exactly one of prefix or key.

roleArn.description: The role to assume. Required unless endpoint is set.

externalId.description: The external id the role's trust policy requires. Defaults to the tenant uuid.

endpoint.description: An S3-compatible endpoint instead of AWS.

credentialRef.description: With endpoint: the VaultEntry holding the access key for it.

git.description: Documents in a git repository over HTTPS (GitHub, GitHub Enterprise Server, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo or any git server). A matching ForgeConnection is used when there is one.

ref.description: A branch, tag or commit. Defaults to the default branch.

paths.description: Globs, relative to the repository root, selecting the documents.

path.description: A file or directory, absolute or relative to the config or repository root. Read by the CLI only: at scan time it applies locally, and config apply uploads a snapshot so server views match.

urls.description: Plain HTTPS URLs, each fetched with ETag and If-Modified-Since.

sha256.description: Refuse the document unless its SHA-256 matches.

auth.description: A request header carrying a credential from the vault.

teaId.description: A TEA identifier (urn:tei:...) or a uuid.
